comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-1935 couples a scaffold transom by positioning it, closing a cap, swinging a bolt and running down its nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate must counterhold an adjustment screw while tightening a concentric jam nut; PR-1935 supports and aligns a long tube, operates a hinged cap and bolt, and spins a single fastening nut.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires preserved angle and repeated motion after release; PR-1935 requires the transom on its mark, square, capped, bolted, gripped and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Running down a scaffold fastener does not require preserving a calibrated screw position against its locknut or verifying retained articulated travel; no rubric details are missing.
